name: default_transaction_deferrable
description: Sets the default deferrable status for new transactions, enabling delayed scheduling of read-only serializable transactions to improve concurrency.
symptoms: Serialization failures in long-running read-only queries
Unnecessary transaction retries under high contention
Poor throughput for read-only serializable workloads

constraints.hard_rule: value == true implies default_transaction_isolation == 'serializable' and transaction is read-only

tuning_tips: Enable only for applications issuing long-running, read-only serializable transactions; leave disabled for mixed or read-write workloads since it has no effect there.
